----
I-Phuze
I-Phuze (pronounced i-Fuse) real name Cleon Wright  is a Jamaiacan/American musical artist, audio engineer, and creative professional. He is known for his independent work in music production, performance, and multimedia content creation, incorporating elements of contemporary hip-hop, experimental sound design, and visual storytelling. I-Phuze is a United States Army veteran.
Early life and background
I-Phuze was born in Mandeville, Jamaica, grew up in May Pen Clarendon  and later relocated to the United States. He served in the United States Army, an experience that influenced both his artistic perspective and professional discipline. Following his military service, he pursued music, audio engineering, and digital media production.
